name: ScreenDub
tagline: Record your screen and ScreenDub writes the script, narrates, and exports a product demo or tutorial video in 70+ languages
description: Record your screen and ScreenDub writes the script, narrates, and exports a product demo or tutorial video in 70+ languages. FScreenDub turns a screen recording or a slide deck into a finished, narrated video and a written step-by-step guide. No script to write, no mic to record, no editor to learn. Hit record in your browser, or upload an MP4, WebM, MOV, PDF, or PowerPoint. ScreenDub detects every on-screen action, pins it to a timestamp, and writes a clean narration script you can edit line by
